decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster extends the firm's core coolant management expertise, so its in-house R&D can keep interpreting field results and refining the system.
The cleaning centrifuge builds directly on the firm's filtration know-how, so customer feedback can be absorbed and turned into improvements at low risk.
The scraper belt chip conveyor sits at the centre of the firm's conveyor knowledge base, which makes its performance signals easy to read and act on.

The hinged belt chip conveyor is a core product type closely tied to the firm's engineering and service capabilities, and after the portfolio was streamlined in 2024 it remains a strategic part of the line.
